bureau: Credit reference bureaus licensed by the Bank of Sierra Leone
note: The Credit Reference Act, 2011 (Act No. 4 of 2011, Supplement to the Sierra Leone Gazette No. 22 of 5 May 2011), in the Bank of Sierra Leone's copy, read by eye (a scan without text) from archive.org's snapshot of 9 July 2025 (bsl.gov.sl doesn't answer this environment; the Parliament's copy is a two-page fragment in every snapshot). Section 15(1): a credit reference bureau shall maintain a record of the history of the credit information it receives for a period of ten years from the day of its receipt: written as keep 10 (the Act counts from receipt of the information, the game from the late payment). Section 16(2)-(3): all financial institutions submit credit information once every month to every credit reference bureau, including payments made on time and late, with no threshold: written as reported 30 days after the due date (a monthly cycle). No amending act was found among the archive's captures of the Bank's site; a later text wasn't found in the search either.

sources.title: Bank of Sierra Leone: The Credit Reference Act, 2011 (Act No. 4 of 2011), scan (archive.org snapshot of 9 July 2025; read by eye)
sources.said: 15. (1) A credit reference bureau shall maintain a record of the history of the credit information that it receives for a period of ten years from the day of the receipt of the information. ... 16. (2) All financial institutions shall submit credit information once every month, in the form prescribed by the Central Bank, to every credit reference bureau, regarding the extension of credit made by the institution, without prior consent from their customers. (3) The information shall include details of loans or payments made on time and late payments.
